item.name: Conversation Operations

query.description: Specifies the maximum number of results to return in a single response. It controls the page size.

Zero-indexed integer representing the number of records to skip before starting to return results. It calculates the starting point by multiplying offset and limit, enabling systematic retrieval from large datasets.
Specifies which field to use when sorting the results. Must be an existing field name in the schema. If none or an invalid one are given, it will be set as "inserted_at" by default.
Determines the sorting direction of the results. Accepts "asc" for ascending or "desc" for descending order. If none or an invalid one are given, it will be set as "asc" by default.

request.description: Retrieve a paginated list of the active session user's conversations with the assistant.

variable.description: Unique identifier of the conversation to retrieve.

request.description:
Retrieve a single conversation with the assistant that  
belongs to the active session user. This endpoint returns the full  
messages list.

query.description:
Specifies the model to use for generating responses. It must be a valid OpenAI model, such as "gpt-4o-mini" or "gpt-3.5-turbo".

Full models list: https://platform.openai.com/docs/models
Controls the randomness of responses. A value close to 0 makes responses more deterministic, while a value near 1 makes them more diverse.
Specifies the maximum number of tokens in the response. Lower values limit the response length.

request.description:
Initiate a new user's conversation with the assistant by  
sending the first message(s). The conversation, including the  
assistant's response, is saved in the database. This endpoint returns  
the full messages list.

query.description:
Specifies the model to use for generating responses. It must be a valid OpenAI model, such as "gpt-4o-mini" or "gpt-3.5-turbo".

Full models list: https://platform.openai.com/docs/models
Controls the randomness of responses. A value close to 0 makes responses more deterministic, while a value near 1 makes them more diverse.
Specifies the maximum number of tokens in the response. Lower values limit the response length.

variable.description: Unique identifier of the conversation to update.

request.description:
Continue a specified conversation by adding new message(s)  
and requesting a response. The updated conversation, including the  
assistant's response, is saved in the database. This endpoint returns  
only the assistant's latest response message.

variable.description: Unique identifier of the conversation to delete.

request.description: Remove a single conversation with the assistant that belongs to the active session user.
